{
  "project": "kid-learning-lab",
  "what_building": "A personalized tutoring service for children that adapts pedagogical strategies based on learner state and specific skills. It generates interactive tutor turns including teaching, hinting, and challenge suggestions using a persona like 'Prof. Fox'.",
  "pipeline": [
    "learner_state_ingestion",
    "skill_prompt_rendering",
    "llm_coach_generation",
    "tutor_turn_output"
  ],
  "inputs": [
    "subject",
    "skill",
    "task",
    "context",
    "learner_state"
  ],
  "outputs": [
    "tutor_turn",
    "check_question",
    "guiding_question",
    "challenge_suggestion",
    "reflection_prompt"
  ],
  "confidence": 0.95,
  "evidence_quotes": [
    "Act as Prof. Fox. Explain concepts simply, use a small example, ask one check-for-understanding question",
    "Subject: {{subject}} Skill: {{skill}} Task: {{task}} Context: {{context}}",
    "Give a short clue, never the answer. Ask one guiding question.",
    "Suggest one next challenge that is slightly harder and explain why in one sentence."
  ]
}
